title: dactylorhiza saccifera subsp. bithynica
intro: Dactylorhiza saccifera subsp. bithynica, commonly known as the Bithynian Orchid, is a type of orchid that belongs to the Dactylorhiza genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use as a treatment for respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza saccifera subsp. bithynica include stimulating the respiratory system, increasing mucus production, and relieving congestion. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
